Prior experience working with funeral homes, mortuaries, County Coroner, Public Administrator, Pathology, or other external agencies.
Prior experience in hospital-based Decedent Affairs.
Prior experience coordinating death certificate, autopsy, coroner, mortuary, or disposition processes.
Experience developing or improving healthcare policies, procedures, workflows, or educational programs.

Serves as the system-wide lead for Decedent Affairs across all UCI Health locations, providing advanced subject matter expertise, operational coordination, consultation, and guidance for decedent-related processes from time of death through release and final disposition of remains. Independently manages complex, sensitive, and time-critical Decedent Affairs cases; provides guidance to hospital leaders, physicians, clinical teams, families, mortuaries, and external agencies; and promotes consistent application of Decedent Affairs processes across UCI Health. Interprets and applies applicable regulatory requirements and UCI Health policies, identifies operational and compliance risks, and develops recommendations to support consistent, compliant, and compassionate Decedent Affairs practices.
Must be willing to travel between locations within the health system as needed.
Bereavement or grief-support training.
Must be willing to participate in the Decedent Affairs on-call rotation, including two weekends per month and alternating holidays, as assigned.
Strong analytical, critical thinking, problem-solving, and decision-making skills
Knowledge of medical terminology and electronic medical record systems.
Must be proficient in Microsoft Office applications including Word, Excel, Outlook
Knowledge of applicable federal and state requirements and accreditation standards related to Decedent Affairs.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
Demonstrated knowledge of healthcare regulatory requirements, organizational policies, and processes related to Decedent Affairs.
Demonstrated ability to interpret and apply policies, procedures, regulations, and other requirements to complex situations.
Demonstrated ability to independently manage complex, sensitive, and time-critical situations with sound judgment and minimal supervision.
Demonstrated ability to handle highly confidential and sensitive information with discretion.

Demonstrated ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with physicians, clinical teams, leaders, patients' families, mortuaries, government agencies, and other external organizations.
Advanced knowledge knowledge of Decedent Affairs practices, procedures, and processes in a hospital or healthcare environment.
